_meta.note: H.E.R.M.I.S message catalog. Single source of truth: the plugin (Python) and the overlay (JS) both read it. Add keys to es.json and en.json together; the i18n test fails if one is missing.

welcome.gestures_off_body: Turn them on with /hermis gestures on. The camera only runs in autopilot mode and the images never leave your PC.
welcome.gesture.fist.name: Fist (held)
welcome.gesture.fist.what: Closes the front surface; with no surfaces open, minimizes the active window
welcome.gesture.swipe.name: Swipe ← / →
welcome.gesture.swipe.what: Moves to the previous or next surface; with no surfaces open, switches window
welcome.gesture.palm.name: Palm (held)
welcome.gesture.palm.what: Hides or shows the surfaces; with no surfaces open, shows the desktop
welcome.phrase.show.title: Show me…
welcome.phrase.show.what: Data, a table, a chart or a document floating on screen
welcome.phrase.layout.title: Open X and put it next to Y
welcome.phrase.layout.what: Opens apps and arranges your windows
welcome.phrase.close.title: Close that / Close everything
welcome.phrase.exit.title: Exit autopilot mode
welcome.phrase.exit.what: Goes back to the Hermes you know
welcome.voice.intro: This is the FIRST TIME the user uses Autopilot Mode: besides answering, introduce yourself in 2 or 3 spoken sentences and explain how it works: they can ask you to show things on screen, to open and arrange apps, to close what is on screen, and to exit the mode. {about} There is a quick guide on screen; do not read it all.
welcome.voice.gestures_on: The camera gestures are active; name each one with its function in a single sentence ({gestures}).
welcome.voice.gestures_off: Mention that camera gestures can be turned on with /hermis gestures on.
setup.title: H.E.R.M.I.S setup
setup.subtitle.pending: {count} step(s) pending. Follow the instructions for each step and check again.
setup.subtitle.info: Nothing is missing. Review the instructions of the informational steps.
setup.overlay.missing_deps: The overlay dependencies are missing (they install on their own when you enable the mode, or right now).
setup.stt.elevenlabs_missing_key: ElevenLabs is selected but ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is missing (add it, without the #, to {path} and restart).
setup.stt.missing_local: The local engine (faster-whisper) is missing. If you already installed it, restart the gateway.
setup.language.english: It is set to English (the default). If you speak Spanish, change it.
setup.tts.auto_tts_off: If Hermes only answers in text: turn on the speaker in the Desktop (see the 'On the Desktop' step). voice.auto_tts only covers the terminal and messaging.
setup.tts.elevenlabs_missing_pkg: ElevenLabs is selected but its package is missing.
setup.tts.elevenlabs_missing_key: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is missing (add it, without the #, to {path} and restart).
setup.wake.missing_engine: The wake word engine is missing. If you already installed it, restart the gateway.
setup.wake.installed_disabled: Installed. Turn it on in the Hermes chat.
setup.computer_use.allowed: Typing and using keys does not ask for approval every time.
setup.computer_use.needs_approval: Every time it types or uses the keyboard it will ask for approval. To approve once and for all, choose 'Always' or add this to {path}.
setup.desktop.detail: Choose 'This device' at the bottom of the sidebar (on a remote gateway the plugin does not run). Hover the mouse over the microphone: the ear activates 'hey hermes' and the speaker reads the replies out loud. Without the speaker, the voice chat only transcribes. To talk, use the black button on the right (the microphone is dictation only).
setup.gestures.on: On: the camera turns on only during autopilot mode and everything is processed on your PC.
setup.gestures.off: Off. To close or switch surfaces with your hand, turn them on: the camera only runs in autopilot mode and the frames never leave your PC.
launcher.detail.unverified: Connection not verified in this process.
launcher.detail.busy: Another instance is using this overlay installation. Try again when it finishes.
launcher.detail.failed_running: The process is still running or its exit could not be verified; no other one will be started.
launcher.error.install_failed: The installation failed. Check the npm connection and try again.
launcher.error.install_timeout: The installation ran out of time. Check the connection before retrying.
launcher.error.install_denied: The installation could not run. Check the Node/npm and plugin permissions.
launcher.error.launch_failed: Electron could not start. Check the permissions and try again.
launcher.error.launch_exited: The startup process ended with an error. The retry reinstalls the dependencies.
launcher.error.startup_timeout: No overlay connection was verified within 30 seconds.
launcher.error.process_unknown: Could not verify whether the startup process is still running. No other one will be started.
launcher.error.storage_failed: Could not write to the plugin data directory. Check its permissions.
launcher.error.worker_failed: Could not start the background worker. Try again.
launcher.error.lock_failed: Could not lock the overlay installation. Check the permissions of the plugin directory.
launcher.error.node_missing: {requirement} is required on PATH to start the overlay.
launcher.error.node_unverified: Could not verify Node.js. {requirement} is required; check the installation and PATH.
launcher.error.node_version: Could not verify a stable Node.js version. {requirement} is required.
launcher.error.node_incompatible: Node.js {version} is not compatible. {requirement} is required.
launcher.note.installing_update: opening the overlay; updating its dependencies (~1 min)
launcher.note.installing_first: opening the overlay; the first run installs dependencies (~1 min)
commands.lang.current: Interface language: {lang}. To change it: /hermis lang es | en.
commands.lang.reset: Interface language: {lang} (back to the Hermes one).
commands.status.overlay_connection: Overlay connection: not checked across processes (local startup status below).
commands.check.header: Installation check (read-only; not an end-to-end test).
commands.check.windows_unavailable: Windows desktop: unavailable on this OS
commands.check.voice: Voice: not verified; check voice mode in Hermes.
commands.check.wake: Wake word: not verified; check wake-word settings in Hermes.
commands.check.computer_use: Computer use: not verified; run hermes computer-use doctor on Windows.
commands.check.pending: {count} step(s) missing. See the details with /hermis setup.
commands.check.info: Everything is installed. There are {count} informational step(s) to review with /hermis setup.
commands.on.failed: Could not change autopilot mode. Check the local plugin logs.
commands.off.failed: Could not change autopilot mode. Check the local plugin logs.
commands.gestures.failed: Could not change the gestures. Check the local plugin logs.
commands.tour.done: Guide shown. Show me… to see a surface, or /hermis tour to replay it.
commands.tour.header: H.E.R.M.I.S tour: Hermes will explain Autopilot Mode on your next message.
